I wan't someone to find out how well this tactic performs outside the Arena, it might be more risky, might be more effective, can't know until someone finds out, that's your job now.

Take these rifles, the cleanup crew scraped them off some fallen gladiators. No manual included, you're on your own with figuring out how to use these things, got it?
sources.68a32567cf5a19b50bd7d72e description:
So, I have the feeling that you came back to collect some data on weaponry, am I right? Guessing that you're looking for work, good thing you reached out to me my guy, I got work to be done. I know I can rely on your skills here, and you know that I pay well, right champion?

Anyway let's move on to your actual task... Assault Carbines.
Indeed, you heard that right brother.

Gonna take care of it? Take out some targets with each of these weapons that are available on the market. I assume this will take you some time, but I expect to hear from you very soon! Good luck out there champion.
sources.68a3257525fac53439e9a7b3 description:
Hey hey hey, we're not done here my friend. There's more than just these types of weapons, you know that I wasn't joking with that, right? I really want to test you here, I hope you get that.

Of course you'll be paid! Who would I be if you'd be left unrewarded for your troubles. Anyway, I assume you want to know what you need to do now, alright then. Take down a few more targets, but this time you use submachineguns, I will give you the list, these should do fine for now.

I have some spare ammo for you, keep in mind that these weapons are terrible at getting through armor. So watch where you're shooting, but a trained mercenary like you already knows I suppose.
sources.68a32583e08103bac7759f5c description:
Let's continue, that look on your face already screams "Excitement", am I right? We haven't gone through all the submachineguns yet, remember?

This will be a cakewalk for you, more modern weaponry, some of them are also much better at armor penetration, I'll even give you some spare ammunition of course, everything for you champion!`But hey I don't just go around throwing top-tier bullets around for free! You have work to do, and I expect it to be done flawlessly, got it? Consider it an investment.

I'm feeling really confident here when I say you won't disappoint me, make sure this statement stays true. Got it?
sources.68a32591c51bdf186d33dad2 description:
Pistols are an essential tool, always have a backup on you, something more or less unexpected could always happen, your weapon jams, you run out of ammo, you name it... Unfortunately for most operators, not all of them carry a sidearm on them, I assume you also fall into this category. Shame, it could really put your life in danger, and I still need you, got that?

All the local scum has been more active lately, I need someone to solve a few problems here and there, can you do that? And while we are speaking of pistols, why don't you take out some of them with your sidearm? Gets you some training with these things, let's start with some western pistols. I'm sure you won't have any trouble getting them from your trusted vendors, right?
sources.68a325a301d14e90ad47c1d8 description:
Alright then, we're moving on now. Western pistols are all cool and all but what about ours? We got mostly older weapons, back from the soviet times, but the newer ones kinda lack the modularity. You're at a slight disadvantage here my man, you gotta play this smart.

These weapons use terrible ammunition, going for unarmored areas or straight for the head is your only option here, and I mean it. Copy?.
sources.68a3252fd029cf07bf9561d2 description:
Relax, you're almost done with all the handguns, but you had it easy before! This won't be a cakewalk, so I think you should take this a little more serious. But hey, look at it from the bright site, most of these guns can shoot some proper ammo now, cool right? Well, anyway... I'll be a little generous here, the cleanup crew scraped off a few of these tools from some fallen fighters recently so you can have them, they should still be in decent condition - Ammo not included!

I'd be eager to see you deal with this. Not everyone is able to handle these kind of weapons, especially around here where they're much harder to get. You think you're fit enough for this challenge?
sources.68a3251e545f5a09d4d6000b description:
Shotguns? Alright then, for some reason all the bandits out there love these things, what a pity... For you PMCs. Anyway, I need a bit of data collected, and you're the perfect one for this kind of task, you proved that before, yeah? Glad I can rely on you, mhm.

I'll split this task into two parts again, you will start off simple, none of these weapons are complicated to use, or even expensive. One thing about these weapons is that they absolutely annihilate anything without armor, and guess who mostly runs around unarmored - Scavs. Sounds fun, right? For you at least, your targets will have a hard time fighting you, sure... Take down whoever you want, it will count, after all a kill is a kill. I'm not trying to cheat the system here my friend.

Speaking of cheating the system, care for a sample? A few of my looters found those recently, but none of them use shotguns, so I thought it would be perfect to give them to you, on the house of course. So, why are you still here, champion? Duty is calling, Tarkov's streets won't clean up themselves.
sources.68a3250cfa963fc4257282c9 description:
"Happy Hunting". That is exactly what I've been told when my cousin lent me his shotgun to put some food on the table. But now is not the time to drown in nostalgia! We can save that for another time... Maybe.

Well then... Where was I again? Oh, yeah, your task. Shotguns again, right? Fantastic. You'll be able to enjoy some more interesting weapons, I can give you this american-made one, it's super expensive so I suggest you don't lose it. Got it? I'm not even sure if anyone of the dealers has them in stock, probably not. After all we had to chase down a few gunrunners for them.

Alright, I'll quit "chatting nonsense", so rude of you... Here, have the list aswell, come back when you're done, and you know what? Keep the shotgun.
sources.68a324f0e5c58491cf1cc17e description:
So we're opening the big chapter here? Let's move on then, shall we? Assault rifles might just be the most common type of weapon you're seeing here in Tarkov, after all they are just good at everything from a certain point of view, short ranges, long ranges, fully automatic with high firerate, you name it. But I think we should begin this small and simple.

As always, I'm giving you the list of all the guns you'll need to test for now. We got some classics among it. You can pick whatever SCAR rifle you want, they are all essentially the same, at least to my eye...
I had this friend once, he chose to join USEC right before the contract wars escalated, always told me about his rifle collection, it was full of western bullpups. Pretty neat stuff if I'm honest. But we're not here to collect artifacts or anything, you know what to do.
sources.68a324e08f8840a01589ddd2 description:
Ah yes, right as I was speaking about "common type of weapon", It's like the AK grows on trees in russia. Do I really need to say much here? Of course not! Sure, you can have the list, I'm not paying you to figure out what your task is in the first place, who would I be? Anyway, you look like your ears could use another story, fine.

My cousin who supplied me with certain stuff to go out hunting, you may or may not know that already, he became a gunsmith, eventually. He only worked on AK-type rifles, and I mean "only". He pretty much built every possible configuration of these guns, barrel length, caliber, stock type, everything really. His dream was opening his own gun store to sell his abominations, unfortunately for him that never worked out, fortunately for our eyes... No offense to him, but some of these guns looked butchered. But after some time he did manage to get employed at KIBA Arms, good for him.

Sadly I never heard from him ever again when all the things started to happen here in Tarkov. Don't give me that look, you expect a happy end everywhere don't you? Now go.
sources.68a31c0682f6f122b650f97e description:
End of the line partner! Just kidding, we're only closing this specific chapter soon, after all those would be all assault rifles we can get our hands on. You haven't collected data on all of them yet, some of the very special ones are still left. Mostly high caliber rifles but also some very rare guns

Lots of people question how some of these weapons ended up in Russia, let alone Tarkov. I had to do some research on those guns, fascinating, even in the countries they were made they seem to be incredibly rare, the SIG SPEAR specifically, it's a very interesting gun indeed. Despite it's rarity, you operators seem to love it, I'm guessing it's because of the caliber and firerate, right? Alright then, you do your job, I handle the paperwork, have the list, because the SPEAR ain't the only tool you will use.

Good luck out there champion, there won't be any samples this time.
sources.68a317daa4acb2d09cc8822b description:
Your biography surely is interesting, "Tarkov Shooter", what a nickname huh? What's gonna be next? "Psycho Sniper"? Oh come one, give me a break, but in all honesty, you should read it yourself, you know how it is. Lots of shady actors, some people know more about you than yourself, it's pretty scary if you think about it, so I suggest you do your thing and try to get out of Tarkov as soon as possible... Unless you belong here?

Enough talk, alright alright. You have work to do, sometimes a little story time is important though, don't you think? Sure, you won't be in the history books, at least that's what I think, but you will definitely be a local legend! Looking at your previous history, I don't think I would be wrong to think that this won't be a difficult task for you, right? Of course not, look at you! You're a pro. You'll manage, without a doubt.
sources.68a317ca41081fb3942fd195 description:
For some reason PMCs here in Tarkov love DMRs, suspicious pattern, you know. You are likely very guilty here too! And I don't blame you, friend. These weapons are excellent, absolutely amazing guns! Don't think I'll hate you and your buddies for that.

But I wouldn't contact you to tell you that, besides you already know that yourself. You need cash, gear and guns, and I need data on these firearms. So why don't you do what you do best huh? I'll even lend you some stuff for the job, you think you can take care of it? I'd be more than impressed if you would complete your task. And don't worry, the job with match the payment.
sources.68a3179c948da416d15ba726 description:
Only one class of weapons left, are you excited? I suggest you stock up on ammo this time, I won't be handing over any spare gear for you this time, you got that? No offense but you know, I'm also just a business man, you wouldn't give me any free stuff either, would you? That's what I thought.

Anyway, duty is calling! Machine guns can be excellent tools to take care of your work, but you know how it goes... "The car is only as good as it's driver" or something like that. These things are very heavy too, so doing some training would be a smart move, but that is your call.
sources.680390e437806877136227f6 description:
There's something Lotus and me need your help with - Right now if possible. This Arena guy found out about these Terragroup drugs. I have no clue how he figured that out! I made sure to get rid of all our tracks. We were the only ones knowing about it, well now it's time to act.

We need help with finding a decent hiding place for these stimulants, I can do the part with moving the actual cargo, you only need to find a good spot. Can you do that? This stuff shouldn't become accessible to some "gladiators" or the Arena administrators, it's some serious stuff you know?

I was thinking about the mountain, there should be some bunkers there, cultists used to live in there back then, but now they are sealed and nobody ever goes there .So can you lend a hand here?
sources.6816279e5c48eee9720f64be description:
So did the BTR driver explain everything to you? Excellent. Everything we know so far about Ref gave me a few ideas - You see, his people work together with Glukhar's gang. That's where you will cause some distress, let me explain the plan.

Locate these people and just attack them, I suggest you do that from a distance, they are well coordinated and can really mess you up quickly in their environment, just make sure to leave the gang leader alone.
sources.68162986c103ecdd90256073 description:
I wanted to offer you a very special job for an urgent matter, but it has to wait, something unexpected happened. Someone attacked my associates, well they didn't suffer any big losses but a lot of their members got hurt really bad in the process.

Recovery will take some time and they ran kinda short on medical supplies so that's where their next problem starts. You know I can't leave my trusted colleagues behind so I need to act somehow, your help would be very apprechiated of course.

I can help you establish a better reputation among local bandit groups if you decide to help my friends out - Come on champion! This would be a Win-Win situation right here!
sources.681633be8d093606deceedea description:
So where were we? Oh yeah right, the job I wanted to offer you previously...

My guys gathered some intel about some kind of experimental drugs that Terragroup has been working on - Combat stimulants if we want to get specific here. I mean why should you care anyway, who knows if these things are safe or not? I guess my men will find out, but your job is the actual important one, you actually need to find some of the shipments that contain these drugs.

If the intel is correct there should have been a truck carrying this cargo through Priozersk, so your best bet is to look there, don't forget to mark the thing once you find it. Understood your assignment? Perfect, I expect you to come back very soon champion.
sources.682a396d504c405d6044c7ec description:
Hello again champion, there's bad news... for both of us. We weren't the first ones to stumble upon the Terragroup shipment, someone else emptied the container long before you arrived. Now I could only guess who else knew about this - After all this was classified.

I have a friend, he had his "connections" with Terragroup, in some ways at least... Anyway, someone must have done some information gathering, you don't just find this out of the blue, we're dealing with experts here so whoever got the cargo knew about everything. I only know what I am allowed to know.

Well this friend of mine tried leaving the city center and head down to the laboratory, not really successful since he had to leave his car before he could even get close. I guess it's worth checking out the place, right? I suggest you bring a marker or two just in case you find something worth mentioning.
sources.68ab5622e4e279831c33454d description:
The dots aren't really connecting here... And that really grinds my gears.

I still have ways to gain information on this, don't worry. As far as I know, Terragroup had their ties to Tarbank in some ways, I'm sure someone from Terragroup left some evidence when the situation escalated. Try looking for something worth checking out inside the Tarbank office near the Empire building.

I heard one of them was holding a meeting during the evacuation, surely something was left behind. Just in case you find a computer or laptop that belongs to one of them, you should take a USB flash drive with you to download certain files, I'm sure you know computer basics, right? Oh and leave the flash drive plugged in, I will send people out there to pick it up, I know... Not the safest approach, I have my reasons.

I assume you have visited the Tarbank building before, so you know the situation can get quite heated when some bandits want to get to your through the stairwell. Have those tripwires and grenades, maybe you can take down some people with it, just be careful and not walk into them yourselves, got it?

I know this guy won't come home again... Like ever. So I guess he wouldn't have a problem if I tell you his adress, if you want you can take a look at his place, maybe you find something useful?
Keep whatever loot you find of course, he lived at Malevicha Street, Apartment 5.
sources.68ac5a291ad19f8bca0e4b57 description:
Wanna know what this whole operation was even about? I'm sure you already forgot why we are doing this in the first place. Haha, well I can't blame you, that was some time ago now where we noticed these shipments. Now, I'm not saying we wasted our time here, but... I think we need to head a few steps back. Somewhere in the customs zone, you and your employers were investigating these strange shipments... Yes, I knew about that, but that is not the important thing right now, we got work to do.

Down at warehouse four you once spotted a ural truck that was transporting terragroup cargo, right? Well, here's the thing, your associates thought that they were transporting cargo to that warehouse, but in reality... They were transporting it from that warehouse, at least that is what intel says, and it's your job to find out, look for evidence and plant some markers on them if you feel like it.

Also... The files you downloaded let us get our hands on some parts of Terragroup's database, so we have access to a few shipment logs, cool right? But like I said, "a few". One of my scav contacts stumbled upon an office that looks suspiciously intact, it was located inside the building west of the big construction site somewhere in the customs zone, you know... The building with the giant silos, where the snipers always sit, yeah that one.

Anyway... Maybe you can find something important inside the office, another laptop or computer perhaps? Assuming you will find it, bring a flash drive. Download all necessary stuff and keep the drive plugged into the computer, got that? I'll make sure some of my guys will stay close to the area. Leave the zone once you're done so my guys can grab the USB thingy without needing to worry about shooting you by accident.

I'll hear from you soon... Hopefully.
sources.6812590e15f6bcbc89c75b34 description:
Hello again, brother! The streets have been awfully silent lately, I heard you're good at taking care of local crime bosses and other scum. Good thing we crossed paths today!

There is this "thing", you know, me and some other dealers are working on something at the moment. You received the news about this gladiator Arena, I assume. Shit, man... Some wild stuff.

There's this guy in town, "Ref" was his name I believe. Anyway let's cut the small talk, this dude had his goons everywhere not too long ago, they were running around looking for some scav and BEAR operator, no clue what happened to them actually - They likely escaped, since I haven't seen the hounds around much recently. However they sometimes patrol some areas, and a little bird told me that they were either guarding or moving important goods - If I would have to guess it's supplies for their "gladiators".

If you'd be so kind to help out a brother, I would be super grateful, ya know? Feel free to take out one or more of his dogs, I heard they carry some sweet equipment. Very well then, I hope I can hear from you later.
sources.6812941396bf52b87fada560 description:
Hi! Ragman let me know that you are also involved in the "thing" now, I'm assuming he already explained what this is about, right? We have dealt with this Ref guy before and let me tell you this... Multiple of these operations at once are a big deal you know, it's not easy and it's definitely not cheap. We could use any help we can get and you are one of our most valuable and reliable people.

So are you interested in a job? Of course you will be paid, as always, when have we every disappointed you, soldier? Me and Arshavir had a convoy, armored vehicles here, geared guys there - Yet someone still managed to take it down! And the culprit didn't plan on making this a secret, it was Ref's hounds!

The convoy was carrying tons of special weapons to a classified location, I think we lost contact with them near the emercom checkpoint outside the ULTRA shopping mall. I need someone to check it out and see if they took everything or if something is still there.
sources.681295120afc09bdf4472485 description:
Nobody is perfect, we all know that. Luckily for us, this rule applies to Ref's guys to, especially to them. You know... they aren't exactly inconspicuous, let's just put it this way - It wouldn't be much different if they would carry a sign that reads "Working for Ref", you know what I mean?

Anyway, you're probably wondering already why I am telling you this, let me explain before you get dizzy from all this nonsense. Very recently I hired a few PMCs to take care of a some small jobs outside the laboratory, and they seem to have spotted the Arena guys, at least that's what they told me, if they were right is a different story. But this is where you come in handy!

Some of the security cameras inside the lab are still operational - Apparently...
These tapes must have been saves somewhere, I asked some of my associates and one of them said that when "shit hit the fan" in Tarkov and the lab got evacuated, there was one of the security chiefs giving a presentation in the auditorium. If one of his personal devices is still there, we might find something that could give us the access to all the video tapes.

There is one more thing you need to do however, bring a few radio repeaters and set them up near the three elevators used for exfils, my goal here is that we might catch some of their radio signals - Hopefully when they are giving some important comms. Can you manage this? I can lend you some of the gear of course.
sources.6812967df2e90afe81ef3b59 description:
I got good news, very good news actually! The laptop you found inside the auditorium actually contained access to most of the camera footage, cool right?

Turns out that these goons actually made their way into the Terragroup lab, and by the looks of it their motive was finding one of the servers, this place is full of this stuff after all. From what I can tell by the footage we got, they were near the weapon testing room working inside some sort of office, I don't know how to describe it, it had a orange-colored tarp over it, there were lots of computers and lots of servers, shouldn't be too hard to miss, right?

Haha alright then, take this USB drive, one of my guys uploaded a special software onto it, plug it into the server and leave it there, make sure to clean out the area - We can't afford people sticking their noses into this operation. Got it?
sources.68129c189210aba950e5d57b description:
Glad to see you again, I'll walk you through this again, I'm so excited for this! It's like getting tickets to a movie you waited years to see, with front row seats and everything! Ahh, good times... But we can't afford to get distracted by nostalgia now.

Other dealers were notified about these weapons - Good thing for us is that they don't have a clue where they could be! But they want them as if their life depended on it, me and Lotus discussed this scenario already, the choice lies in your hands my man, you have the responsibility. If someone asks you for the weapons, just grab them and give it to them, unless it's some super shady motherfucker it's for the greater good, otherwise it's entirely up to you who you give the weapons to.

You might want to wait before some of them start contacting you. In case you lose the case I'll let someone stash it in the container again.
sources.68129ced44202136962c541c description:
Mercenary, we have observed the current events, now we decided it's time to step in. A new player in town has been terrorizing my men - But not directly, you might ask yourself "how"? Well it's simple, he's supplying certain people with weapons, people that we don't have any business with, yet they keep attacking us, looting our outposts and leaking important information about trade routes.

We recently managed to intercept one of his shipments, it was temporarily stashed in one of the containers outside the ULTRA mall, as far as we are concerned it's locked away safe and tight. We need to cut off these supply routes.

There is a great prize waiting just for you if you managed to solve this problem for us, and don't think about making a move here, we got our eyes everywhere merc.
sources.68129d0adb209aeef7100be1 description:
Well hello, long time no see. I know times were difficult for you and me recently, but this can be a good day for both of us - If you decide to help me of course!

Now let's talk business, locals have intercepted weapon shipments that have been going around recently, nothing unusual here, but the problem here is the people that receive these weapons, they are causing nothing but trouble! They are even worse than the local scum, and we have to treat this by it's roots.

So I am asking you for a favor again, I can't allow these weapons to circulate around Tarkov, come on you know it's better for everyone if you lend a hand here.
sources.68129eb2b43bb4d35d9f5c9a description:
Watch your step! Haha just kidding. There won't be any warnings when these fuckers enter that container, there will only be a "boom"! Problem solved. Sounds great, doesn't it?
This plan is fool-proof! We can bet if you doubt it but I know you, you wouldn't doubt me ever, and that's what I love about you my guy!

Now let's talk about your part of this task, I paid a few local bandits to piss off these hounds a little, taunt them and shit, whatever it takes to make these arena fellows angry. I hope they figure out that their valuable cargo is gone now, only one way for them to find out! They gotta check the super secret hiding place - Which isn't so secret anymore since it got busted.

Hurry up with setting up the booby-traps tho, they might already be on their way, bad guys don't wait for you my man.
sources.68135e68f72643bf2a708c5d description:
I am sick and tired of all these "pranks" you pulled - To put it lightly. You are someone special to me, someone I thought could be trusted, I welcomed you with open arms and what did you and your friends do? Is this your way of saying thanks? Alright then, you're lucky im not letting people shoot you on sight, let me at least expect some gratitude.

Here are the good news, if you can even call it "good". I have a long list right here, full of open contracts that nobody wants to do, you know I wanted to reserve all the interesting jobs for you but you wanted it to be this way, now enjoy doing all the dirty work. You should be happy you even get work at all! After everything that you did to my people, I even have trouble looking into your eyes, but I like seeing the good in people - However, don't see this as me forgiving you, I absolutely despise what you did, but we might be able to leave this behind us... Mostly.

Let's start with something that can't be messed up easily, and nothing which you can exploit, you understand that? Here's the list, I don't want to hear another word from you until this is completed.
sources.6813d49816860442e2a11c2f description:
You still got a ton of work ahead of you, so listen up! I'll only explain this once - It's a simple task. The local scum at the lab really pissed off my guys lately and causing nothing but trouble. I need them to pay back in blood, they looted most of our stashes aswell and took our gear.

Here's where you come into play, take down these animals and make them pay. We can continue talking about our future work after you're done, got it? According to my intel they mostly roam around the military base bunkers and trainyard aswell as the Terragroup laboratory - Don't forget most of these guys have been through the same training as you, the only difference is their gear.
sources.6813d64b31f920cdbc15ab23 description:
Keep that in mind, you really damaged my trust with your operation against my guys, and I don't think I'll forget what kind of moves you pulled on my dogs. All our routes were leaked thanks to your work! We can't afford any more ambushes, most of our previous routes aren't safe to use anymore, so we gotta find new ones.

Why don't you take the lead? After all you already know where the hounds roam around - Find some safe exfil routes there and we might be able to leave the past behind us. It's essential for our survival - And it's essential for you aswell, copy?
sources.6813db938449d87cea2cf14a description:
You were reliable with the last few tasks so I guess you can get a more interesting job now. I need a bit of gear tested for the cleanup crew - Active headsets, to be specific. Different brands.

Shoot down some local scum or operators, whoever you cross paths with, I'm sure you can find trouble easily - After all you are like a magnet for that. Use these headsets while you do it and find out how well they work in combat, I can't give my guys cheap hearing protection after all. Bring me back the headsets when you're done, don't expect any gifts from me my guy.
sources.68b06a005f3eaaf2a27bb49a description:
At the end of the day, your help is essential to me, so I must forgive you for the past. But don't think that I will forget your stunt, after all it caused some irrepairable damage to my business. How about you pay me a little fee to cover some of the damage, hmm?

I know you're not the kind of person to throw money around to anyone, but hey... Come on now, you know that yourself, you messed up my guy, you were like a brother to me and you knew that too, I would have never pulled something like that on you! Fine, I'll quit the dramatic act, but you have work to do my friend, got it?
sources.68b075f82fe99bf60e9ad7f2 description:
I noticed you're not the kind of person that wants to help with ordinary jobs, not the average mercenary like your colleagues, well... I can't blame ya, friend. You want something special, something demanding perhaps, alright then, I have the perfect task for you. Just keep in mind, we're dealing with very serious people here.

Someone from the government reached out to us recently, probably secret service, FSB maybe... Anyway, this man wanted us to clean up a little mess here in tarkov, you see someone established a well organized smuggling business here, and apparently it's causing them trouble to investigate Terragroup or something like that, guy kept it pretty vague, guessing that these people didn't want to share detail with us normal folk, right?

I don't know if you have encountered any of these "smugglers" yet, I certainly haven't seen them myself and so did my hounds but according to this guy they exist, and they cause enough trouble that the FSB got wind of it. The info I was given tells us that they turned the construction side east of the resort on the Azure coast into their base of operations, funny, right? Taking over other's property... Just like that, yeah.

Allegedly they used the gym in the basement of the west-wing of the resort as one of their main dead-drops, so I suggest you check that out too, you decide in what order.
sources.68b07a0c7bb2dcdc1c0d572e description:
Hey, of course we're not done here! You think this guy tells us everything at once? Amateurs... So impatient.There were three smugglers who caused most of the problems, and this guy wants someone to check out the places that they used to hide out. Fascinating... These people can just live inside this place in the middle of all the fighting and chaos and they didn't seem to care.

The first smuggler lived inside the customs zone. If you know where warehouse 7 is, somewhere inside of that. His name is Yuri

The second one, Timur, another one of them, had his hideout near the coast inside a small village, it's directly next to the cottages, west of them.

The last smuggler was called Vova, the FSB guy said he was the craziest one of them all, lived inside the reserve base, what a maniac... You will likely find his base near the knight buildings, close to the sewer exfil. That's everything I know.
sources.68b07b66e0d3845de90e086a description:
Our man got a little more comfortable with sharing information with us, he wants us to call him Victor. He said he once led a special operations team that raided drug labs and criminal's safehouses, wild stuff man. He said right before they had to evacuate Tarkov someone stole their vehicle, a blue van. Since it's tracked they know it's location but none of his guys feels comfortable going inside of there because of the local gang, you know who.

It's inside the garages at the white knight building, Victor wants you to locate the van and plant a marker on it. After you did that you should clear out the area, who knows what scum is lurking around there, maybe one of the thieves is still walking around there! But it shouldn't matter who you take out, after all we don't know who exactly stole his car, and honestly even gives a shit.

Make sure to come back in one piece, I don't need to waste any more money on doctors and medical supplies on my "employees".
sources.68b07cd25a4cafa65a846d57 description:
This job won't be directly related to Victor, it's from his superiors, directly from the government. I'm just saying... But I really expect your highest level of professionalism here, got that? Don't make me look like a fool.

Anyway, the reserve base is still full of military equipment. You might have seen these strange flak tanks just standing around. Apparently they are called "2K22 Tunguska". And these guys want to know where they are all located, they need to be marked too. There have been an estimated amount of six tanks left there to rust on the premises.

Unless you want to walk past one I suggest you check on all the garages and bunkers in the training areas. Victor's superiors felt generous enough to donate you a bit of gear to help you fight your way through the base, a kind "thank you" is apprechiated haha!
sources.68b08361d560747536f0930f description:
Victor was thinking about sending out a few of his guys into Tarkov to clean up after the smugglers and probably to get rid of them aswell, interesting use of resources, hmm. Anyway he asked me if I know someone that could tune his guns, and I think I know the right person to ask this question. He gave me a few SR-2M submachineguns and some pistols to go along with them, also gave me a list of standards that have to be met. You think you can manage that?

SR-1MP Requirements :
 - Durability higher than 75 %
 - Magazine Capacity of 18 or more
 - A Suppressor
 - Zenit Klesch-2P Flashlight with Laser

SR-2M Requirements :
 - Recoil Sum less than 220
 - Weight less than 2.9 KG
 - Ergonomics 65 or higher
 - Durability higher than 75 %
 - Magazine Capacity of 30 or more
 - Sighting Range of 200 Meters or more
 - SR-2M Pistol Grip ( Black )
 - SR-2M Polymer Handguard ( Black )
 - Zenit Klesch-2P Flashlight with Laser
sources.68b08a981f4236176e8f0fed description:
The guns you built were absolutely amazing, that's what my guy Victor said at least, I think I can trust him.

He wants to know about a few more things before he actually deploys his men in Tarkov - Specifically check on how their gear performs, they run mostly russian gear, obviously... 9x21 guns, the ones you built, NPP KlASS equipment, high-cut helmets here and there, you know. Anyway, he wants to try them out in the zones where you found the hideouts of the three smugglers, you think you can do that? Of course you can, come back when it's done.

Specified Gear :
 - SR-2M Veresk 9x21 Submachine Gun or Serdyukov SR-1MP Gyurza 9x21 Pistol
 - Any NPP KlASS Bodyarmor or Platecarrier
 - NPP KlASS Tor-2 Helmet, LShZ Lightweight Helmet or any Ops-Core Helmet
sources.68b0a88fb31efae4dc7ee064 description:
Our guy Victor wants our help with one last thing. He needs some maps to get a basic idea of how the area is structured, a few topographic survey maps should do just fine but he also wants to know how to navigate the health resort on the azure coast, after all not everyone knows the place in and out like you, right? Funny guy...

Anyway, where was I again? Oh yeah, right. He needs some money too, cash, western currency. He said he can cover most of the cost in roubles, I assume that won't be a huge issue for you. So can you bring the stuff?
sources.68c0bfe82d85ac7091436bb2 description:
I assume you have heard the news, no? Well let me share my wisdom, champion. These smugglers weren't just some nobodies, apparently some of the local dealers are involved in this aswell, I knew some of these guys were shady but wow... Didn't know they had that much dirt on their hands.

This Skier guy who works at the port is a really greedy fuck, I know you work for him occasionally, so you might know what I am talking about. He's an important player in this line of work, however he isn't the only one, after all there are many shady people in town. This "Fence" guy is a perfect example, nobody knows who he is or if he's even real, I mean what's the deal with him? Rumors have been floating around that Fence isn't actually one person, but a collective of them, but who knows and honestly who cares.

Both of them are a problem. In case you're interesting in taking care of this mess, you're welcome to think of a way to help with that.
sources.68c0c208f0fcd1b184750ffd description:
So, I was right, you did earn their trust huh? Cool. Before we make a move on team we need to check up on something else. Last time my hounds roamed around the woods, they found some scavs near the outskirts, they were quickly captured without resisting, information was more important than killing these bandits after all. Anyway, my men interrogated them and they admitted that they're working for Skier, such a coincidence, am I right?

Well we now know about a few of his dead drops, we just need to find out his routes now but I have other people working on that as we speak, so your task will be something different now, got it? Go check out their dock, perhaps it will give us some info, also there should be a small shack nearby, apparently it's usually filled with some goods, maybe they use it to temporarily stash their smuggled wares? I wanna take a listen to them in the future, so place a radio repeater there, can you manage that?
sources.68c1eff9c5b5f2e47b774a57 description:
Actually, I need another favor.

Few of my guys have been engaged in the smuggling business aswell, the thing is that they are kinda under-geared, since they don't do this work under my command but more as "their own thing", I think you young folks would call it a "side hustle"? Well... Anyway, let's get this out of the way then, shall we?

You can't carry anything if you have you use your only two hands to hold your rifle, eh? I decided to step in, and help my boys out a bit, help in some way at least, what kind of boss would I be if I'd let my guys suffer like that, huh? Well I ain't that kind of person, and I don't think you'd be either, so if you're interested in... you know - Helping out a friend here?

I'm willing to compensate you for your trouble of course, so if you want an extra paycheck this month help us gather a few large backpacks.
sources.68c312d1609a82be2a2d52db description:
Now that we got all the simple side jobs out of the way, let's get back to the important things, we got work to do. My men managed to obtain some information about the potential locations of Skier's smuggling routes.

Maybe you know where these places might be located? After all you know Tarkov pretty well, you should consider becoming a tour guide, eh? Alright fine, all jokes aside now, this is serious. Apparently one of Skier's routes goes through the Azure Coast aswell as Cape Dalniy, the second route might be between the military base and the water treatment plant at Cape Dalniy, perhaps you should visit the areas where these places connect?

That's about all the information I can give you, sorry champion but I can't always feed you with every wisdom there is outthere, sometimes you gotta search and find. Keep your eyes peeled.
sources.68c31bd427110f29df6be2ab description:
Now that we got all the simple side jobs out of the way, let's get back to the important things, we got work to do. My men managed to obtain some information about the potential locations of Fence's smuggling routes.

Maybe you know where these places might be located? After all you know Tarkov pretty well, you should consider becoming a tour guide, eh? Alright fine, all jokes aside now, this is serious. One of the two smuggling routes should be between the customs zone and factory four, the other one should be between the business center and the main city.

That's about all the information I can give you, sorry champion but I can't always feed you with every wisdom there is outthere, sometimes you gotta search and find. Keep your eyes peeled.
sources.68c31f71aa355c62f3b4f6e3 description:
Hey! Guess what, the places you checked out turned out to be the smuggling routes of our dear friends! My hounds shot up a few of their carriers, looks like they had contraband on them, at least that's what I think it is. The boxes are locked but we managed to find keys somewhere else. Basically Fence and Skier work together in this, one group carries the boxes, the other carries the keys, these gangsters are smarter than I thought - But not smart enough, because luckily we have you!

Anyway, I think I managed to establish a stable supply connection for this shit, for a price you can get this stuff yourself, how does that sound, eh? I could only guess what is inside, I didn't want to risk having both groups carry one part of the contraband and the other one carry the key to that! It's all about playing it safe, you know. This is a dangerous place, nobody can afford being at the bottom of the food chain.

And don't forget, curiosity can often turn into the biggest disappointment, do not blame me for anything terrible that is gonna happen.
sources.68c322a2a56a64e8084d538f description:
So it turns out these cases have some sealed boxes inside, not sure what they contain, it might be something simple, but also something important, Terragroup documents maybe? Who knows, but one thing is certain! Skier wants his stuff back. I had the idea of hiding all the boxes, you can never be too careful after all, and this operation requires all my attention for now. I was thinking about hiding them close to the areas where my people usually roam, keeping my people close to these valuable goods is important.

The first spot should be at the docks near the sawmill in the forest, the second spot should be inside the kitchen of the restaurant at the pier at the Azure Coast and the last spot should be inside the blockpost at the industrial zone, you might need to take out a sniper or two for that. Are you able to complete this job?
sources.68c42206071c2a5f10ea8202 description:
So, merc, how is your adventure? Don't bother answering, actually. We know, we know everything and we see everything, we have our eyes and ears everywhere, and word gets around quickly in Norvinsk, and you aren't exactly an unknown being.

We lost certain cargo recently, and yet again Ref's people have been involved, there is a great reward for any information on this, and you are the kind of person that is willing to rat out on everyone if the price is right, you are a mercenary after all, money is everything for you.

Let us tell you one thing - Think twice before you act...
sources.68c422290241ea1aa4fb9587 description:
Yo! I assume you heard the news, huh? No? Well then let me explain, some assholes took down a few of my guys, they had valuable goods on them and now it's gone! They even found where we stashed most of these wares, can you believe it? This is an outrage!

I reached out to you in hopes of you willing to help me catch these fucks, this is absolutely unacceptable and I am ready to pay a fortune for any tips that lets me solve this riddle. You look like you could use some extra cash, so what is it gonna be huh? There's always money to make my friend, and I always have work for you mercs.

And don't think you can do some sneaky move here, I trust you and I don't want you to abuse it, because that would be the last thing you would do. So... Interested in lending a hand?
sources.68c422298f2722ca9f7d24a3 description:
Hey there! How's life? Everything alright? Cool!

I was informed about some current events, nothing that affects me actually but it did catch my attention in some way... Is this about Ref? Ugh... I am kinda tired of this stuff, but on the other side I would really like to profit from this, and damaging his Arena business in any way is always a win on my side. Apparently some smugglers were taken down recently? Smugglers that seriously damage my own business! I just have to get involved in here, you know?

If you know about anything, or if you have some way of helping here, I'd be super grateful if you would be able to make yourself useful here, I have some extra gear you might like and nobody is ready to buy it so getting it for free might be something you'd be interested it, hmm?
sources.68c42fd92a030b87c52e2f65 description:
Fuck, I have bad news, terrible news even! Some of the dealers got their hands on the cargo, this can't be good... We need to make our move now!

You gotta hide some of my cargo at a place where my men can get it out of the region, the KPP camp would be perfect for that! Some people might still be there to let someone exfil out of Tarkov. I suggest you stash the cargo not too close to the gate, at one of the watchtowers near the road might be a good idea. We gotta lay out some baits aswell, you'll deal with that part, I'll make sure these people actually know about the decoy, stash something that will disrespect them in some way, I'll leave that decision up to you of course.

You should act fast, because these people already know about this whole thing, you understand? So, start moving!
sources.68c432f157baa1fbcd13447d description:
Yo, lad, I got something for you, it's important so take a listen, and don't get distracted by some birds. This Ref guy stole some of my goods, you remember that I suppose, well guess what, I got a lead on where he hid some of the cargo, no idea what he wants with them, perhaps this is like a deal or something and he is waiting for his buyer to pick it up, perhaps not, who knows.

Anyway, I need someone to find the place, tell me if the cargo is there or not, I might send over someone to check it out, maybe we can catch the buyer off guard and squeeze some information out of him? Oh I meant to politely ask him for details on this case.

I believe it's close to warehouse three and four in the customs zone, I think you once checked out the zone yourself, right? You're familiar with that place so why don't you take a gander.
sources.68c438d9fdcd3c3aa8c96f62 description:
Woah! Slow down there cowboy, I still have a job for you. You see... This Ref asshole thinks he can trick us, do you know what this guy did? He stashed a pack of spoiled milk at the dead drop, is this some kind of sick joke? Anyway, I guess me and him don't share the same sense of humour, what a weirdo...

I managed to find out more though, apparently he wants to get this cargo out of Tarkov, and you know I can't afford that, that is my property! Mine! He is planning to ship it out of the region via the KPP camp, so I need a way to send someone inside there, and don't worry I won't send you inside of there, it's dangerous after all...

So I need a full ratnik loadout, some insignias and a Terragroup keycard, make sure all the gear is intact and bring all of the pieces directly to me, don't lose it and definitely don't give it to anyone else who is asking for this stuff, you got that? If you choose to play some dumb move, I will notice so do what's right buddy.
sources.680e0c71597b0c96599d5587 description:
Have you noticed anything out of the ordinary recently? I heard there's something weird happening outside of the Arena, and I doubt it's just rumors.

Not too long ago one of our trusted associates has gone missing without any trace, as if he never even existed in the first place. "Ryba" was his name by the way, he lived in the industrial zone, had his hideout there. It was located somewhere near the ZB-011 bunker, and speaking of...

Could you inspect that bunker too? I heard it gets used to extract from customs by operators like you, find out if it's still usable, maybe it can help us somehow.
sources.680e12e530d8f164e7fcd99b description:
So my friend Ryba always told me about some local group he had trouble with, I'm pretty sure he called them the "Svetloozerskiy" gang, I assume they live by the lake.

He said if shit hits the fan he's gonna ask one of his colleagues to help him fight these guys. Oh and you know who this "colleague" is? He's part of Glukhar's squad, great I know. So I suggest you don't start some war with them, got it? Anyway, I figured out what to do next, and you're probably wondering why I am telling you all this stuff about these gangs and so on, well it's simple - Ryba had some sort of weapon stash in one of the old abandoned sawmills, nobody ever goes there so it was a really safe hiding place.

Find a barn or some other big building there and check the second floor, look for weapon boxes and mattresses lying around. Don't forget to leave both of the gang leaders alone, I can't afford to lose trust with Glukhar, and Shturman still has a debt to pay, now is not the time.
sources.680e19fee0ca81b62f5a448a description:
Out of nowhere I got this weird feeling that this driver guy might be behind it, either him or the people working for him. Who else goes out there to inspect an old barn? Nobody! It must be him, but we can't let him know that we're investigating this.

Maybe his depot has some clues? Traces of Ryba, maybe he was held captive there - Who knows... But we will find him, dead or alive, only a question of time. If he still has all his gear stashed in his depot you will certainly find it there! Check the buildings, the garages, the warehouses, every spot where you could hide these goods. I'm sure you can take care of it.
sources.680e1fe9bb891db767cc10a2 description:
Uhh... yeah I got something, you seem to behave differently than usual. Is there something I need to know?

You know what, actually I got an idea - Bring some drinks, we'll sit down at the depot later and discuss this, you give a really strange vibe right now, you know? Seems like something serious. You can tell me what you want to tell me, you know you can trust me.
sources.680e6fa7f03da221e8c72a7f description:
So, what did he say? Does he know something? No? Very suspicious if you ask me. But we can't make a move until we have more proof!

There are still ways to gain some information. Some of the Arena champions still have their hideout hidden somewhere across the Tarkov region, there are four specific ones that we should check on. There was this gladiator, Shatun was his name, he hid in a village in Priozersk. The others were Grumpy, Voron and Leon, all of them had a hideout aswell, I think one of them lived inside the power station outside the ULTRA mall, another one was living near the health resort and the Leon guy lived in an old house near the USEC base.

You should check on the room's condition, maybe they were opened up already, but maybe they are still locked, your job to find out. Can you do that? I'm counting on you champion.
sources.680e21a059d722e8adfef054 description:
Yeah, now that you told me about your situation, there is actual work. You told me about some "Ryba" dude and an Arena administrator, I think people call him Ref - Not a big name outside the Arena but you know, word still gets around. However, he does have his involvement in more and more events out here.

Anyway, this Ryba fella wasn't just someone, he was a smuggler and he had a lot of contacts outside Tarkov, contacts with people that could seriously endanger you, me, Lotus and most other dealers. One of your ex-PMC buddies took care of it, it won't be any of your concern now, believe me. We found his weapon stash, looks like he was preparing for something big, you could find everything there! Machine guns, sniper rifles, rocket launchers, loads of explosives and a ton of crates filled with armor-piercing ammunition, this guy knew weapons.

Well I need someone to drop off some of this gear at certain locations, can you do that? Make sure you bring a big bag. I suggest you ask Lotus for help, I think she still has the rest of the gear in her possession at the moment.
sources.680e3923013c853dc48a35bb description:
Hello soldier, I was notified about all the previous events, you do realize you could get yourself into deep trouble here, right? But I can help you. Oh and about the gear that you need to hide, you can take it, at least all of it that I have. The rest is long gone already.

Anyway, you see, this friend of Ref who gets called "Ryba" had a really dirty past, he was working for Terragroup, and he wasn't an ordinary worker either, he held a pretty high position actually. Some of my guys found some evidence on that inside the Lab not too long ago, but we think there's more, he wasn't mentioned by name officially in these documents, but somewhere there might be personal belongings.

We also found CCTV footage of him visiting someone else's room in the residental unit, he went in with some blue book or folder, and he came out empty handed. I assume he hid it in there. The room belonged to some Vladimir, maybe you'll find the evidence inside there?

But the room is locked, you will require a keycard to get inside.
sources.680e778d7b773d357db874c5 description:
Something just came to my mind, we might have a problem soon, a big problem... You better listen up, this is very important, it could endanger everyone of us.

I remember Ryba hiding documents inside the Terragroup Lab, very confidential information, something nobody should know! Not you, not me. What you need to do is find this folder, if you tell anyone I will notice so don't attemp to pull some sort of sneaky move. Anyway, located in the residental unit there should be a room, in there lived a Vladimir guy, apparently he was important but this ain't anyone's problem now, who gives a shit. The actual important part is that Ryba stashed the diary in there once the unit was evacuated.

Find this letter, diary, or whatever, and hurry up! This information can't reach the public under any circumstance, do you understand?
sources.680e807527f51292fa6b2f9e description:
Okay, everything is copied and stored securely in a safe place. Now to step two - We found someone who needs this diary, and we are very certain that this man wouldn't do anything stupid with it, and I think you know him already, it's the man in the tower.

I hope you already have the signal transmitter or whatever, so you can bypass all the mines on the lighthouse bridge. His snipers shouldn't shoot you on the way there either so you will be safe... Hopefully.

Anyway, you know what to do. Someone might have ratted us out, and now some people know that we have this diary, I assume this Arena fella will ask you for it. Remember the damage he can cause with all this information in his possession.

Do the right thing.
sources.680e8127463f0c3d59af8056 description:
Hey there! Word got around that someone obtained Ryba's diary. We can make our move now! I think it's one of the local dealers, I knew it! These greedy assholes, it was clear from the very beginning.

You know that I need this diary, and I know that you need money, gear and whatever else you operators require for your daily killing and looting. What you receive if you bring me the diary is way more valuable than the diary will ever be to you, I promise, just bring it to me, you won't regret it but you will regret it giving it to someone else. So consider your position carefully.
sources.680e808b6d94abeb5a2dbc70 description:
I was contacted by your employer, Lotus. I know we had a troubled past but we can leave that behind, if you decide to keep your promise of course... Oh which promise? Let me refresh your memory then - The diary by the man named "Ryba".

Do you have it on you right now or do you expect to bring it anytime soon? I have been looking for any information on this matter for a long time now, and finally I know how to get it. Do the right thing warrior, it's a cruel world out there and you can help making it better.

Just don't give that man this diary, or else you'll put all of us at risk.
sources.68650f0e18ac344def323e7c description:
So, we got the story about the diary out of the way now, it's time to move on, I still don't know what exactly happened to Ryba, is he dead? Captured? Did he manage to escape? So many questions but very few answers... You look like you could use some work, I'll pay you a fortune if you can help out a bit. We are in this together now, champion!

I hired a few PMC operators, guys like you, maybe not so trustworthy unless you pay them enough, but hey they did the job just fine so I am in no position to complain, I had them do a little "intel gathering" for me. I know that the tank driver guy is involved in this, I am one-hundred percent sure! They managed to find out some things about it, turns out he was looking for people that could help him clean up his mess, they acted like they're interested in help, they mostly did their work of course, the driver thinks he's all good now. Shame... If only he knew.

Alright alright! I'll quit "wasting your time", your job is simple - The driver had my PMCs hide evidence of Ryba's disappearance in room 220 inside the three-story dorms building near the customs area, he made sure they locked it up though so you're gonna need a key. You think you can do this?
sources.6865144e611f20e8e30f88d8 description:
I finished examining everything which was on the drive, it contained digital documents aswell as photographs and video footage. It's official now - Ryba is dead.

The driver's PMCs interrogated him and then took him out, they held him captive inside the customs zone, at least I think that's the location... The warehouse looks familiar, I could have sworn we stored supplies in that exact warehouse, I think it was warehouse three.

I want you to rig the place with a camera while you're at it, I am curious if anyone else will be investigating that place anytime soon. Understand what you gotta do? Don't mess this up, champion.
sources.68665a3b90bfb5b2fc3eab8d description:
Now, that gives me an idea... Why don't we steal some stuff from the driver's base? I'm sure we can find something of value, or at least something slightly useful in there, don't you think? Of course! You'll need to ask him to take you there, the place is guarded by marksmen and the area is full of mines, it's just too dangerous that way. You need to get inside their legitimately so bring some cash.

I got a bit of gear right here, take it, a signal jammer and a marker. What I expect from you now is to enter that depot and plant the jammer in the entrance, the one with the containers. We might be able to disable some of the traps that way, and just maybe we can send in some more people. And in case you find something useful there, mark it. We could use some heavy weaponry so I suggest you keep looking for a machine gun, stuff like that. Got it? Great, I expect to see you soon champion!
sources.68a9da7f5c276fa9585a313d description:
Back then I used to work with some gunrunners, one guy specifically catched my attention, he was a russian marine, knew his business - Then one day everything went to shit, and now we're here. Anyway, I started working with him and his crew, that guy is Glukhar, you know who that is.

Well this stuff is classified, so I'll try to keep it as vague as possible, I hope you understand it but it should still give you enough information to help with this task. I had this contact, he was also involved in this operation with Glukhar's crew, helped with some important things. He had his office inside the reserve base, it was the airspace control center security room in the white king building if I remember that right, it's on the third floor and I need someone to check it out.

Somewhere in the white knight building on the second floor he also had his own workshop, fixed up some small arms here and there when he had the time, nothing too important... But I think he still has a mounted 12.7mm machinegun stored in there. So I'd say you find it aswell, plant a camera there if you manage to find it. I need to keep it under surveillance for later. Oh yeah and by the way both rooms are locked down tight, so you'll need to find two keys, I think they were called "RH" and "MP22".

Rumors have been going around that he used to escape the military base through the sewers and then made his way to Cape Dalniy, if that is true that must have happened before the USECs turned the water treatment plant into their base because I assume they would have lit him up if they would've seen him. Well anyway, we'll never know exactly what happened unless we would somehow manage to find this guy alive, but that is out of question for now. I need to know if the exit is still usable, so get moving.
sources.68aa055fda2fdadeda09f85e description:
So... Cape Dalniy, about that. I'm guessing he tried to escape through the ocean, there's a small pier at the beach west of the train depot near the water treatment plant, a few rowboats were kept on that spot. He might have used one of them to get out of there.

A few of my guys managed to get their hands on CCTV camera footage from the northern checkpoint and it showed how he ran inside a small shack and came out a few hours later, guessing he took some rest in their, maybe he left us some clues? Check out the place, take this marker with you just in case you find something, and if you do, please use the device.

Now, the pier... What's up with that place to begin with you might ask? Well obviously, multiple boats were parked there, likely used to evacuate a few people. Not sure how many managed to get out, if any...
Since you'll be close to it, I suggest you check out the beach aswell,
sources.68ab372dd492a4e0af84a924 description:
My contact seems to have prepared his "escape plan" inside the shack, managed to scout the area at night. He said there were four boats remaining on beach, and you said you only saw one, so I assume he made it out. I'd say we're done with that task, time to move onto bigger fish.

My hounds found some strange barrels at the scav village, the same blue barrels used by Terragroup, likely special chemicals to manufacture their "drugs", I need to make sure they're still there. A PMC that worked for me too was scouting the mountain bunker near the village, told me something about these barrels aswell, also spotted some strange symbols in there. But when he said he's gonna go there again to take a closer look, he didn't come back... Suspicious.

You don't think the hooded people have something to do with it, do they? I guess we'll need to have a "chat" with them sooner or later. But I think you should try your luck here, I suggest you don't go at night but that's your choice if you want to come back in one piece. Oh and please, find my guy, dead or alive.
sources.686504c9546711656b0cdd70 description:
Hi there! I think I found something useful for our case. By the looks of it, the alliance between Ref's people and Glukhar's gang seems more important than what meets the eye. You already know about Glukhar's past, he was a russian marine, in case you forgot. Well anyway, rumors tell that both of them had a certain past and had been dealing together a while ago already. Unsure how that flew below the radar...

I assume some of this was before the contract wars escalated, somewhere out there you should still find some documents, some form of signed contract between them. We had a mole inside the Arena, but he didn't find anything, apparently Ref's guys don't have their paperwork on hand, or they keep it somewhere outside the Arena.

Another option would be that Glukhar is the one who keeps the paper, or it's lost somewhere inside the military base. If I were you I would check the offices inside the D-2 bunkers, if you won't find anything there you gotta search all the offices in the barracks, got it?
sources.68b85170b361cb40dcf8035e description:
We know a lot more about this case now, thanks to your work of course. This Ref guy seems to have way more connections than I thought, pretty dangerous connections. You know that's not something we can just ignore, right? And his friend Ryba had a lot of ties to Terragroup I suggest you head down into the city center, the documents you brought earlier mentioned something about Tarbank, maybe we can find something useful there?Banking records perhaps, that would be super helpful, you know.

Maybe you should check out the ATMs? One of them might still work, take a radio transmitter with you just in case you find one. Also USEC had their ties in this thing too, after all they were working with Terragroup, since the business center was the hot zone of the contract wars. It's guaranteed that you will find some sort of stash full of weapons, maybe even directly outside the Tarbank building? Well, just in case you find something, please mark it.

I also suggest you clear out the building if you manage to find something of importance. Thank you, and good luck out there.
sources.68b8520b2a60bcf0690ecb1e description:
I already expected you, ha! Lotus told me about the case, glad to see we're not done with this, this thing didn't die with Ryba, Ref has even dirtier connections to some really bad people, we need to work together here to "solve that problem", you know what I mean.

There a some things you could help me with aswell, Tarbank was accused of handing out loans to some people who have been secretly working for Terragroup, I'm guessing that is how they managed to get some extra funds, makes sense doesn't it? Smart but dirty move...
Coincidentally, I once knew a guy that worked at that exact Tarbank office, I remember visiting him once at his work. If we're lucky, we could still find some documents.

One thing I know about Ref is that he likes to hire other operators to do his dirty work, so he might send some mercs to try to cover this up, we might be able to delay this however. Somewhere on the upper floors the USECs used to set up their positions, they likely have some resting place or workshop in the building too, since these places have a lot of usable equipment these mercs might take a look at there first. How about you set some traps there? Maybe you'll be able to wipe out a few of them.

So what's it gonna be, "merc"?
sources.68b858bf6a101c16866aec1d description:
There's ALWAYS work, my friend...

I remember you saying you located some USEC weapon stash outside Tarbank, right? Did you find some electronic device there? Because if you do I suggest you head there again to see if you saw it right. Anyway that's not the only thing you can help with right now. Lotus asked me to help locate one of her contacts, a local bandit, apparently he knew some stuff about Terragroup before this all began. Well he wen't missing after searching for something for Lotus in the hotel near Emercom, strange, I think she'd be very grateful if you would find his traces or some clue.

Speaking of Skyside... I remember Lotus explaining to me how her guys found footage from the CCTV cameras inside the hotel, apparently Terragroup workers have been "chilling" in the lobby right before the area had to be evacuated, looks like they left in a hurry and forgot their belongings, hmm, makes me wonder what precious stuff they left behind?

Also, you should check out the Empire business center, I heard something strange happening around there, don't go in too far though! Also I want you to set up something that let's us survey the area a bit, don't take the books if you find them, if you lose them on your way out that could get us into serious trouble! So what's it gonna be merc?
sources.68c044ff8b79163e3eab83a1 description:
Hey! I heard from the BTR Driver that you found one of my contacts, thanks for helping with that. However I ran into a small problem recently, you see, one of our groups managed to obtain those Terragroup documents from Skyside, the contains were not what we expected...

This is such a mess, apparently some mobsters have been involved in this aswell, and I thought it couldn't get any worse! At least we don't need to search in the city anymore, because the mafia had their little "base of operations" at Cape Dalniy, specifically at one of the Chalets, rings a bell huh? That's what I thought. Lightkeeper is gonna help us a bit here, you know why that is important, right? If you want to escape from Tarkov, this is the only way, understand?

Anyway... The thing we need your help with is investigating these activities, we only know about rumors, so nothing is a hundred percent safe here. Apparently they chased down some messengers for certain documents, important military data. Unfortunately everything escalated shortly after, unfortunately for them. Our guy in the tower told us that he knew a few detectives who had a case going on about these mobsters, but nobody reported them leaving the area, and nobody has seen any of them either, strange...

Well, their boss drove a blue merin car, wonder where he got that money from hmm, probably from absolutely legal sources, right? Haha... No, obviously not. But that won't matter much here, you need to find these documents and find out what happened to this mob boss, can you do that?
sources.68c04fe49d9596f938e9dd2b description:
Hey there! Just wanted to contact you about a more simple job, since some of the local scum and even some more important players have noticed that we're looking into this thing, you know that this can't be a good thing yeah? Maybe some of them worked for the mob back then, maybe they just want all the goodies from that villa, who knows, and honestly who cares, they are a problem that needs to be taken care of.

You know none of us can and wants to endanger this operation, and don't think you won't suffer any damage from this - Remember your ticket out of Tarkov. I'm not threatening you or anything, I'm just stating a fact, you won't be able to make it out of here if we don't help each other, alright? Anyway, you still got that little traffic cone thing? I hope it's working because you'll need to visit the Lightkeeper guy personally, he might have more important jobs for you.
sources.68c050219acd85c21d60b669 description:
I expected you.

I heard you and Lotus started taking care of this already, is that true? Well, in that case, let's continue. However, your work had very little impact to this operation, no offense. It's just that there is way more to this than what meets the eye, you might have expected this, maybe not, you tell me. You want know what happened to the gangsters? They're nothing to worry about anymore, USEC took care of them when they claimed the territory and set up their bases around the premises.

From Zryachiy's observation, nobody actually looted all of their weapon stashes, some where swept clean by the locals, but most of them were left alone, unfortunately he couldn't get a clear view on all of them. It would only make sense to deploy a few footsoldiers there, don't you think? I assume you're already very familiar with that area, so why don't you take a look at it for me?
sources.68c07c94fd7357fff87e46a7 description:
Not quite punctual like I am used to from a "professional", but it's alright. Zryachiy told me that he saw a few of the blue helmets wandering around the villas. I thought they retreated from Cape Dalniy, but by the looks of it I was mistaken.

Speaking of the blue helmets... You weren't wrong when you said that there's more at the villa, Zryachiy's guys found a UN vehicle near the entrance, what the hell are those guys doing there? This is very suspicious, something is wrong. I have my contacts at UNTAR, I always know when something is up, but none of them seem to know anything about it, so either they're lying or the people who have been spotted are doing their own thing, and that is never a good sign.

I tried contacting the rogue USEC group, apparently they saw them walk towards the trainyard but lost contact after. If it's nothing related to building their secret drug operation, I assume it has to do with Terragroup, so I suggest you keep your eyes peeled. Are you able to handle this kind of task by yourself?
sources.68c084031fd16ee291638622 description:
I am glad to see you, "mercenary". I think you're really curious, so I'll try to explain it to you right now. One of the people who has been working for UNTAR was being accused of abusing the situation in Tarkov to establish a drug operation, however nobody was able to prove that, he might have asked you in the past to help with that, he may or may not have mentioned his plans, maybe he was vague... You tell me.

He gets called "Peacekeeper", you might already know, after all you have been working with him in the past already, don't play dumb, I have my eyes everywhere. But guess what the cultists brought me recently, they managed to get their hands on some of his contracts. Looks like he got a few more people working for him now, he hired every kind of scum you can find here in Tarkov, scavs, raiders, contractors, heck even some of the local gangs are involved. They usually operate during the night, I guess they thought they're sneaky, well too bad for them that I found out about that.

Now it's your chance to fight this mess, take these people out, do it quietly and when it's dark. Zryachiy and his guys would be very grateful if you can help out there aswell, you think you can do that?
